defects.summary: Deviation 60 says the C# test `AnUnknownRuntimeOrCapability_IsRefused_NamingWhatIsKnown` and the TS regex at capabilityAdmission.test.ts:166 'went red' when kimi was added, but this is not true: both check the substring 'claude, codex, antigravity, local, api, vibe', and the refusal (string.Join(", ", Runtimes)) still contains it, exactly as the same deviation admits for ConfinementPlannerTests.cs:167.

S5.5.1 checks only that `--cwd` contains 'own/tree', not that it is under the check's scratch, and checks only the `coai-vh` prefix and the `kh-` file name for `--home`, not the full `<root>\coai-vh\<8>\kh-<10 hex>` shape; it shows the scratch and canary are unchanged only through state 'answered'.
`Scopes`, `StandIn` and `ArgOf` are copied into both new test classes (a third copy of AKimiConsultationScenarioTests' helpers) and are not shared.
Dispose resets `KimiHome.AfterUnlink`, which the class never sets, so this line is noise.
The new `why` line starts in lower case ('the kimi rows cite …'), because a sentence was split across array items; this breaks the prose style of the lines around it.

summary: The production change is small and matches the spec: the `kimi` planner arm (Snapshot for disk, Scratch for none, no flags), the three rows with the correct standings, cells and version, the vectors, the generated table, the hand-written Runtimes list, and a flag refusal in KimiConsultant that also refuses `Leading` (recorded as deviation 49). All 12 scenarios are present and pass, the build, format and generator checks are green, and the suite has no new failures; the findings are minor: one false claim in the deviation list, some weak path assertions, and test helpers copied instead of shared.
